basic_info.description: Classic Spanish Mediterranean view home nestled on wonderful block close to Stonestown & Muni! Fabulous wrought-iron gated entrance w/inviting walkway leads to an open arched vestibule w/notable original front door & into a gracious foyer w/center hall & coat closet. Magnificent formal living rm w/vaulted open-beam ceiling boasts a fireplace w/traditional mantel & marble surround, impressive arched picture windows & rich engineered wood floors. Banquet-size formal dining rm w/built-in china cabinets & striking chandelier. Remodeled kitchen showcases stainless-steel appliances, incl a Zline six-burner gas range, Corian counters w/exquisite subway glass-tile backsplash, custom painted wood cabinets, recessed lighting & breakfast rm/pantry w/period sideboard. Expansive 'picture gallery' hallway w/display alcove & skylight leads to the private living quarters. Master suite w/views to historic Sundial Park features a huge walk-in closet, terrific sitting rm & a luxurious marble tile en-suite bath w/dual vanity sink, bubble & jet soaking tub & sep walk-in shower w/fancy, water panel tower system. Great home office w/built-in bookshelves, amazing family rm w/vaulted ceiling & French doors to the garden, laundry rm. Fabulous landscaped backyard w/two-tiered patio & mature plants & trees!
